text:
anya: Heads-up: planned SDK change to tighten delegated auth (require `x-rw-user`) and rename `batch_size` -> `batch`. We need a partner-safe rollout that covers cloud marketplace listings and SI-managed customers.

rahul: Important for marketplace partners. They map SDK behavior into their connectors. Need a test channel and explicit opt-in. Can partners preview the change before we flip defaults?

sam: Yes. Plan: header negotiation + feature flag. If client sends `X-Redwood-SDK-Compat: v2` we accept `batch` and enforce new auth; otherwise v1 semantics. We'll provide a test endpoint for smoke tests.

mike: SRE asks for a short-lived proxy shim at edge to translate `batch`->`batch_size` for non-opt-ins while we monitor. Suggest 21-day window max. Also add metric `compat.header_present` and `compat.migration_success` for visibility.

anya: Good. Add partner-facing artifacts: migration guide, sample snippets (python/js/ruby), and a one-hour partner office hour webinar during opt-in week. Tasha can own the docs + webinar.

tasha: I can draft the migration guide. Example client snippets will include curl + python requests + node fetch. Also propose a checklist for SIs: 1) grep for `batch_size` 2) test connectors on `compat-v2-test.redwood.ai` 3) opt-in form.

rahul: Can you confirm marketplace listing implications? Some partners will need to update their connector versions to mention the new SDK behavior. We'll coordinate release notes with marketplace.

sam: We'll tag the api as backward-compatible during the opt-in period. After the window we flip default. Example header usage:
````
# curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-SDK-Compat: v2" \n  https://compat-v2-test.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"batch":5}'
````

mike: Monitoring thresholds: error-rate delta >0.5% for any partner in opt-in -> automatic pause for that partner. Set alerts to #eng-oncall and #partnerships. I'll own the runbook steps.

deploy-bot: Compat shim deployed to edge stage env `shim-stage-2100`. Canary started (3 partners, 10% traffic) id: canary-2100123456-a.

anya: Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: Announce migration + partner survey + marketplace note
- Day 2: Stand up `compat-v2-test.redwood.ai` + publish samples + opt-in form
- Day 7: Begin opt-in canary (mix of cloud marketplace partners and direct SI customers)
- Day 14: Enable global proxy shim for non-opt-ins (21-day max)
- Day 30: Soft deprecate v1 auth; run final partner sweeps
- Day 40: Remove shim, default to v2, final rollback 72h

tasha: We'll schedule partner office hour on Day 3 and Day 10. Also make a short migration checklist for marketplace reviewers.

rahul: I'll push to partner POCs and collect a prioritized list of SIs/hardware partners that require assistance. Some hardware partners embed SDKs into firmware; they'll need longer lead time—flagging them now.

sam: Note: update SDK changelog and version bump semver major if we remove v1 behavior. We'll keep a compatibility tag in API responses during the migration window.

mike: Also add a telemetry opt-in mechanism so partners can share anonymized failure traces. Flagged as `compat_trace_opt_in` and respect partner consent. I'll confirm GDPR-safe implementation with compliance.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 10% -> canary-2100123456-b. No significant regressions in the last 15m.

anya: Owners recap:
- Partner comms & survey: anya
- Marketplace coordination: rahul
- Docs & partner webinar: tasha
- Edge shim + monitoring: mike
- Header negotiation + SDK samples: sam

anya: I'll draft the partner mail + marketplace note, include migration guide link and opt-in form. Posting draft here later tonight for review. Thanks all :rocket:
